crates/products/chio-proof-room/src/erro.contract: Proof validation and original input errors retain their types. Commerce, risk, runtime regeneration and local-family verification failures retain downcastable native causes; public reasons are selected static literals, never native diagnostic text.

crates/products/chio-proof-room/src/sour.contract: Existing bounded original artifacts, signature/digest checks and collection ownership remain. Selected family verification and runtime-regeneration adapters now preserve native error causes through proof-room; typed public reason selection cannot grant a verified result.

crates/platform/chio-control-plane/src/e.contract: Registry-backed CLI causes stay downcastable locally. Public messages are either registry summaries or explicitly supplied static diagnostics, never native error text or rejected input.

CLI error adapters preserve typed native causes and signed JSON reasons. The static public-source adapter retains actionable proof rejection and exit classification without formatting attacker-controlled source diagnostics.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/dispatc.contract: Catalog identifiers are bounded unique case-folded ASCII names, never paths. Collection output owners validate identifiers and reject non-directory or symlink parent/destination entries before removal or copy.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/input.r.contract: Native signed original-byte decoder preserves full-width integers, rejects duplicate/lossy JSON and retains redacted typed errors. Canonical I-JSON and literal/typed projection are distinct explicit APIs. Regular file and stream readers bound actual bytes before retention.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/input/c.contract: Explicit JSON/YAML selector with no error fallback. YAML rejects duplicate/non-string keys, multiple documents, nonfinite numbers and excessive depth, expanded nodes or string bytes before typed projection.
Count/depth and actual-byte budget shared across each artifact collection. File retention is bounded by remaining capacity before the read; nonregular entries reject.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/input/s.contract: Private bounded snapshot retains bytes across verification and output. Archive paths, all parent-directory entries, collisions and bytes are validated before writing transformed collections. Concurrent hostile ancestor mutation outside captured custody remains a separate limitation.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/input/t.contract: Process-local clock fence locks before observing wall and monotonic time. Fault or regression rejects; explicit deadline addition rejects zero and overflow.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/passport/ht.contract: Timeout and actual response-byte bounds precede original duplicate-aware JSON decoding. HTTP error bodies are not read into public diagnostics; causes are retained behind stable redacted codes.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/dispatc.contract: Graph shape/count bounds precede original file reads, schema and original-byte digest comparison. Retained vectors/maps share actual-byte and entry budgets; swarm optional and required families share one budget.
CLI verification adapts the sealed proof-room verifier result without flattening causes; captured input custody binds subsequent output readers to private bounded bytes.

crates/products/chio-cli/src/cli/chio/di.contract: Shared bounded regular UTF-8 reader serves JSON and seed/text callers; owning current-schema decoders still establish format/signature semantics.

crates/platform/chio-control-plane/src/s.contract: Existing private-file signing custody rejects missing, permissive, multiply linked, wrong-owner or replaced files; nonblocking nofollow reads are bounded and zeroizing from allocation through all exits.

crates/platform/chio-manifest/src/lib_pa.contract: Only current manifest v2 types and signature verification remain. The obsolete v1 converter, migration type, legacy schema and permission amendment APIs are removed; fixture v1 input is negative data only.
